game.name: Nba 2k14 (USA)
game.desc: NBA 2K14 is an installment in the 2K Sports NBA 2K series based on the 2013-2014 NBA season. The game features a number of new improvements and features from the previous entry NBA 2K13. NBA 2K14 on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One contains upgraded graphics, animations, and different modes than the previous generation versions. nnIn Quick Game mode you get to pick a team to face off against the AI or another player. You can choose any team from the NBA and also famous teams from years past such as the '64-'65 Boston Celtics or the '93-'94 Chicago Bulls. For the first time in the 2K series, teams from the Euroleague (European Basketball League) are available for playing. nnThe mode formerly known as MyPlayer has now been changed to MyCareer. In MyCareer you get to create a rookie and take him through his own NBA journey beginning with the NBA Rookie Showcase and the NBA Draft. This mode features scripted cut-scenes and allows interaction with your agent and general manager. Throughout the season you will be given chances to make your own decisions such as if you want to change your agent or which sponsor you would like to endorse.
